detailed_descriptions.en: Sephiria is a top-down rogue-lite that blends fast-paced action with a strategic inventory management system. Play as a rabbit from the village atop the tower and change the fate of a tower where ruin has taken root. Descend through its floors, meet a cast of animals, and uncover the threat waiting at journey's end — all rendered in beautiful pixel art. Strategic Inventory System Collect and arrange Artifacts — which grant unique effects the moment you pick them up — alongside Tablets , which empower the Artifacts placed next to them. How you arrange your inventory decides how strong you become. Your Own Way to Fight Master 6 distinct weapons and over 50 unique upgrades branching from them. Combine a wide range of growth systems to forge your own path: unleash devastating attacks with Magic at the cost of MP, push your stats to the limit with Miracles , and shape your playstyle before each run with Talents . Threats That Stand in Your Way The tower is filled with threats determined to stop you. Face more than 60 distinct and dangerous enemies, and over 10 unique bosses. Across a journey spanning 6 chapters, the challenges ahead grow ever greater. (The Early Access build currently includes Chapters 1–5.) Join Forces Team up with friends — or strangers — in online co-op for up to 4 players to explore the tower together. Trade items, revive fallen companions, and claim victory as a team! Early Access Sephiria is our second title following Dungreed . Throughout Early Access, we'll continue adding new items, new chapters, and refining the balance based on your feedback. Join us on this journey — we want to complete this tower together with you.
